summary: Comprehensive backend+frontend regression for Letters module page-layout (sections) refactor. All checks pass: form matches shape-1, layout modal uses TipTap editors with no range sliders / no drag page, LetterSectionsEditor applied inside Letterhead form too, letterhead sections fallback applies to drafts when sections not sent, preview-pdf accepts letterhead_override.sections, section-defaults returns required keys, full E2E draft→finalize→PDF→revoke with greeting marker persisted end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: letters.tsx is ~390 lines but dense; consider extracting IssueTab/LogTab/SettingsTab into separate files (DRY, maintainability).
issuePayload is recomputed on every render inside preview debounce effect but excluded from deps via eslint-disable; acceptable here but worth memoizing to avoid subtle stale closures.
seed_data_creation: Draft م-19 created and finalized to 18/خ/26 during E2E then revoked (cleanup done). Letterhead sections patched then restored to original.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_letters_layout_sections.py. Must set REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var when running pytest since module reads it at import time (no default). Marker string used: 'تحية اختبار 777' / 'تحية_اختبار_777_UNIQUE_LH'. letter-layout-done button closes modal; TipTap editors selected via '[data-testid=letter-layout-greeting] .tiptap'. Finalize consumes a serial number — in test env we revoke afterwards.
